author: AllisonESpencer
text:
Anyone else concerned that those in-charge of #ImmigrationReform have no idea how a person claims #asylum? 🤦‍♀️ 

To claim asylum, a person must either be inside the U.S. OR arrive at a port of entry. People arriving at the U.S. border are being vilified as “illegal immigrants,” while in reality, crossing an international border to seek asylum is not illegal according to BOTH U.S. and international law. There’s no way a person can ask for a visa or any type of authorization in advance, they just have to show up. A person also has up to A YEAR after entering the U.S. to claim asylum.

There is so much to unpack in the bill that is awful, but complaining about people who have already been GRANTED ASYLUM working (which is already legal) is not one of them.  

I'm a Children's Illustrator and I understand this. Why is this so hard for those in #Congress to?
#Politics #BorderBill
